sql: SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS n_states FROM noaa_wildfires WHERE region IS NOT NULL AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region ORDER BY n_states DESC
SELECT "Region", COUNT(DISTINCT "State") AS n_states FROM "PublicView_RAWS__3515561676727363726" WHERE "Region" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Region" ORDER BY n_states DESC, "Region"
SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS n_states FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 WHERE region IS NOT NULL AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region ORDER BY n_states DESC

SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS n_states, COUNT(DISTINCT state) FILTER (WHERE state IS NOT NULL) AS n_states_nonnull FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 WHERE region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region ORDER BY n_states DESC
SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM noaa_wildfires GROUP BY state ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT region, state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM noaa_wildfires WHERE region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region, state ORDER BY region, n DESC
